label: Repair incomplete Celery schedule configuration
instruction: Return only complete schedule.py, maximum25 lines. Import crontab from celery.schedules. BEAT_SCHEDULE dict has two entries: elm-year-end-rollover task modules.leave_elm.tasks.elm_year_end_rollover schedule crontab(month_of_year=1,day_of_month=1,hour=0,minute=0); elm-task-sla task modules.leave_elm.tasks.elm_task_sla schedule crontab(minute="*/15"). TASK_ROUTES={"modules.leave_elm.tasks.*":{"queue":"default"}}. Close every string, bracket and dictionary. This is worker configuration only.
